narrative: On the board. One leaf, the ink still dark, lying on the desk in the light of two dips. The window is black. The writing is prose, and then one line set by itself. He has not ruled a number in the corner. He has not written an act. On the board. He slides the leaf under the other sheets, not on top. The top sheet is still the place where the queen's waking is to go. It is blank of that waking. The pile is not counted.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Placed the leaf underneath, and left the top sheet for later.

entities.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream
entities.context: Shown on draft in Under the others
